editorial:
Imagine you are a reporter just trying to get a big story, but you end up in a nightmare. You follow a lead about a woman who jumped from a burning building, only to find out that some very creepy witches are behind it. The vibe is a wild mix of a detective story and a holiday horror show. Since it is set during Christmas, you get that weird contrast of festive lights and dark rituals. It does not really follow the other movies in the series, so you can just jump right in without feeling lost. It feels like a trippy fever dream that keeps you guessing about what is actually real.

The special effects are a bit dated, but that actually adds to the charm if you like old-school horror. The pacing moves fast, and the twists are genuinely surprising. Some parts might feel a bit cheesy, but that is part of the fun. If you love weird 90s movies, you should definitely give this a shot.
endingExplained: At the end, you find out the main character was actually being groomed to join the coven. The big twist is that the entire scary experience was a test to see if she was strong enough to be a witch. She ends up surviving the ritual, but instead of escaping, she accepts her new power. The movie wraps up with her becoming part of the very cult she was trying to expose, leaving you with a dark ending.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 90s horror and weird cult stories.
